'''House Nawaz''' is a noble house in [[Arad Doman]].

The House was one of the founding Houses of Arad Doman, as Lord [[Ahran Nawaz]] co-founded the nation with Lord [[Jalaam Lazari]]  and Lady [[Bastine Almadar]] after taking [[Bandar Eban]] in c. {{fy|1096}}.<ref name="comp">[[The Wheel of Time Companion]], Arad Doman.</ref>

The House has not been mentioned in the late [[New Era]], and it is therefore known whether House Nawaz still exists in the present day.
